==Acquisition==
Speak to the [[Seeker of Whispers]] in [[Chantry of Secrets]] after achieving [[Lightbringer rank|Brave Lightbringer]] (1,000 points/rank 3) in the Lightbringer title rank.

== Notes ==
*Works with all [[Lightbringer#Demonic Servants of Abaddon|demonic servants of Abaddon]], excluding the [[spirit]]s they summon.

== Trivia ==

* Lightbringer Signet was an elite until the August 7, 2008 update. Until it was fixed in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20110714|July 14, 2011 update]], this skill counted toward the [[Elonian Skill Hunter]] title track, allowing up to 141/140 elite skills captured.
* The Seeker of Whispers calls this skill ''"Lightbringer's Focus"''.
